name: secret-guard
description: Holds a prompt that carries a credential shape and offers to send it redacted, telling Claude where the value really lives.

scanPrivateKey.title: Scan: private keys
scanPrivateKey.description: Hold prompts holding a PEM or OpenSSH private key block (-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----); the whole block is redacted.

hintPrivateKey.title: Where private keys live
hintPrivateKey.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted private key. Never put a credential here.
hintPrivateKey.default: the key file on disk (for example ~/.ssh/id_ed25519), referenced by path

scanShopify.title: Scan: Shopify tokens
scanShopify.description: Hold prompts holding shpat_, shpss_, shpca_ or shppa_ tokens.

hintShopify.title: Where Shopify tokens live
hintShopify.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted Shopify token. Never put a credential here.

hintAnthropic.title: Where Anthropic keys live
hintAnthropic.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted Anthropic key. Never put a credential here.

scanOpenai.title: Scan: OpenAI-style keys
scanOpenai.description: Hold prompts holding sk-proj- keys, or a bare sk- key after a space, quote or assignment.

hintOpenai.title: Where OpenAI-style keys live
hintOpenai.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted OpenAI-style key. Never put a credential here.

scanGithub.title: Scan: GitHub tokens
scanGithub.description: Hold prompts holding ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_ or github_pat_ tokens.

hintGithub.title: Where GitHub tokens live
hintGithub.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted GitHub token. Never put a credential here.

scanAws.title: Scan: AWS keys
scanAws.description: Hold prompts holding AKIA/ASIA access key ids, or a 40-character secret access key beside its label.

hintAws.title: Where AWS keys live
hintAws.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted AWS key. Never put a credential here.

hintGoogle.title: Where Google API keys live
hintGoogle.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted Google API key. Never put a credential here.

scanSlack.title: Scan: Slack tokens
scanSlack.description: Hold prompts holding xoxa-, xoxb-, xoxp-, xoxr- or xoxs- tokens.

hintSlack.title: Where Slack tokens live
hintSlack.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted Slack token. Never put a credential here.

scanStripe.title: Scan: Stripe live keys
scanStripe.description: Hold prompts holding sk_live_ or rk_live_ keys.

hintStripe.title: Where Stripe keys live
hintStripe.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted Stripe key. Never put a credential here.

scanAuthorization.title: Scan: Authorization headers
scanAuthorization.description: Hold prompts holding an Authorization: Bearer (or token/Bot) value of 20+ high-entropy characters, or Basic credentials.

hintAuthorization.title: Where header tokens live
hintAuthorization.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted Authorization header value. Never put a credential here.

scanCookie.title: Scan: session cookies
scanCookie.description: Hold prompts holding a Cookie: or Set-Cookie: line with a value of 20+ characters.

hintCookie.title: Where session cookies come from
hintCookie.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted cookie. Never put a credential here.
hintCookie.default: a fresh login in the browser (cookies are never pasted)

scanApiToken.title: Scan: labelled 40-character tokens
scanApiToken.description: Hold prompts holding a Cloudflare-style 40-character token within 20 characters after a label such as token or api key.

hintApiToken.title: Where labelled tokens live
hintApiToken.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted labelled token. Never put a credential here.

scanPassword.title: Scan: passwords
scanPassword.description: Hold prompts holding password: or PASSWORD= with an 8+ character value on a short line; placeholders and config templates are left alone.

hintPassword.title: Where passwords live
hintPassword.description: Told to Claude in place of a redacted password. Never put a credential here.
